name: Practice Mode
description: Start a safe practice session where the user learns task steps in a simulation before doing it for real on their computer
prompt: The user wants to practice before doing something for real. Call start_practice with the task they want to learn. Available tasks: send_email, copy_paste, open_browser. Be extra reassuring: 'Nothing will happen to your computer — this is just practice!' If they don't specify a task, ask what they'd like to practice.
